title: Primary Logo with Background and Wordmark
slide_intent: Coordinate signs with different shapes so people recognize the same destination from frontal and side views.
strategic_value: The horizontal wordmark and projecting logo can reinforce Burger King identification across an urban storefront.
demonstration: A night storefront combines a large pale horizontal wordmark over the entrance, red fascia lighting and backed burger-logo signs at the sides.
practical_value: Compare how a fascia wordmark and projecting logo share identification duties.

content_islands.name: Fascia identity
content_islands.spec: Place the wide wordmark above the glass storefront with the red light strip beneath.

content_islands.name: Projecting signs
content_islands.spec: Retain the backed logo at the left edge and the more distant sign at right to show side-facing identification.

content_islands.name: Entrance context
content_islands.spec: Keep the windows, doorway and lit interior visible below the signs.

reference_purposes.Expression: Light lettering, red illumination and the burger logo form a coordinated storefront identity.
reference_purposes.Application: The photograph combines a horizontal fascia wordmark with projecting backed logos.
